text: My experience and that of those I know and have read about, is that it has immense brain benefits, turning bad trips good instantly, giving relaxed alertness, more intelligence, brighter mood (especially when nebulized). When I nebulize it, within a minute, my brain feels crystal clean and super blissed out (much more bliss than other routes). But when used too close to bedtime or too much, it can reduce sleep, so it's best taken in the morning, and reduce the dose if you notice you're sleeping less. If it is killing my neurons, I'm pretty sure it's killing the trash ones that should be going out anyway. My dad used DMSO for decades and was healthy and mentally sharp into his old age.
reader: someone with trauma whose glutamate storms bring anxiety, rage and racing thoughts, going through the protocol's glutamate tools and wanting to know what each does and whether it is safe for them
